blocks.text: Śiva Sūtras 1.9
blocks.directed: [long pause] Śiva Sūtras 1.9

blocks.text: स्वप्नो विकल्पाः
blocks.directed: [slowly] स्वप्नो विकल्पाः

blocks.text: Svapno vikalpāḥ.
blocks.directed: Svapno vikalpāḥ.

blocks.text: Dreaming consists of conceptual constructions.
blocks.directed: Dreaming consists of conceptual constructions.

blocks.text: Dreams Are Your Mind Making Stuff Up.
blocks.directed: Dreams Are Your Mind Making Stuff Up.

blocks.text: Vikalpa is a hugely important word.
blocks.directed: Vikalpa is a hugely important word.

blocks.text: It means conceptual construction, differentiation, imagination, or determinate mental representation, depending on context.
blocks.directed: It means conceptual construction, differentiation, imagination, or determinate mental representation, depending on context.

blocks.text: Your mind has an extraordinary ability.
blocks.directed: Your mind has an extraordinary ability.

blocks.text: It can construct an entire experienced world without corresponding external sensory objects.
blocks.directed: It can construct an entire experienced world without corresponding external sensory objects.

blocks.text: You fall asleep.
blocks.directed: You fall asleep.

blocks.text: Suddenly you’re late for a mathematics exam.
blocks.directed: Suddenly you’re late for a mathematics exam.

blocks.text: You’re naked.
blocks.directed: You’re naked.

blocks.text: Your childhood friend has become the prime minister of Bulgaria.
blocks.directed: Your childhood friend has become the prime minister of Bulgaria.

blocks.text: And none of this seems particularly unusual.
blocks.directed: And none of this seems particularly unusual.

blocks.text: The mind is constructing appearances.
blocks.directed: The mind is constructing appearances.

blocks.text: But Trika’s observation extends beyond sleeping dreams.
blocks.directed: But Trika’s observation extends beyond sleeping dreams.

blocks.text: Much of ordinary waking experience is also shaped by conceptual constructions.
blocks.directed: Much of ordinary waking experience is also shaped by conceptual constructions.

blocks.text: You remember an argument.
blocks.directed: You remember an argument.

blocks.text: You imagine tomorrow.
blocks.directed: You imagine tomorrow.

blocks.text: You rehearse a conversation that hasn’t happened.
blocks.directed: You rehearse a conversation that hasn’t happened.

blocks.text: You construct an entire future in which someone rejects you.
blocks.directed: You construct an entire future in which someone rejects you.

blocks.text: Then you get upset about it.
blocks.directed: Then you get upset about it.

blocks.text: The other person hasn’t even entered the imaginary conversation yet.
blocks.directed: The other person hasn’t even entered the imaginary conversation yet.

blocks.text: You’ve invented them, invented their words, invented your response, and somehow come out of the encounter emotionally exhausted.
blocks.directed: You’ve invented them, invented their words, invented your response, and somehow come out of the encounter emotionally exhausted.

blocks.text: Congratulations.
blocks.directed: Congratulations.

blocks.text: You’ve been defeated by your own screenplay.
blocks.directed: You’ve been defeated by your own screenplay.

blocks.text: The crucial distinction is that Vasugupta is classifying modes of experience, not claiming that waking sensory perception and dreams are empirically identical.
blocks.directed: The crucial distinction is that Vasugupta is classifying modes of experience, not claiming that waking sensory perception and dreams are empirically identical.

blocks.text: But the same manifesting consciousness is involved in both.
blocks.directed: But the same manifesting consciousness is involved in both.
